body_lead: MUMBAI: The Maharashtra police have been using the MahaCrimeOS AI platform in Nagpur district since April to tackle cybercrime. The system, developed using Microsoft Foundry technology, helps process complaints faster and analyse complex data. On 12 December 2025, the Maharashtra government and Microsoft announced that the platform would be extended from Nagpurâs 23 police stations to all 1,100 stations across the state. âEthical and responsible AI for public good is our core motto,â said Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis.
